visual_action: The video opens with a still image of Donald Trump at a podium in front of American flags. Text is overlaid on this image. The remainder of the video is a slideshow presenting numerous quotes from Donald Trump about his plans to repeal and replace 'Obamacare' with a better, less expensive healthcare plan. Each quote is displayed as text on a plain black background and is sourced with a location and date, primarily from 2015 and 2016 campaign events and media appearances.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The video opens with a photo of him and is entirely composed of a slideshow of his quotes about healthcare, with his name attached to each quote.

cast.name: Barack Obama
cast.evidence: His signature healthcare law, 'Obamacare,' is repeatedly mentioned in the on-screen quotes as the policy Trump intends to replace.

on_screen_text.text: Here are the times Trump promised his “alternative” health care plan >>>

Trump: “You’re Gonna End Up With Great Health Care For A Fraction Of The Price And That’s Gonna Take Place Immediately After We Go In, Okay, Immediately. Fast, Quick.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Las Vegas NV, 2/22/16) Trump: “We Will Come Up With Health Care Plans That Will Be Phenomenal -- Phenomenal That Will Be Less Expensive.” (Trump Campaign rally, Hampton NH, 8/14/15)

Trump On Replacing Obamacare: “We’re Going To Come Up With Plans, Healthcare Plans That Will Be So Good And So Much Less Expensive.” (The Dr. Oz Show, 9/15/16) Trump: “We’re Going To Win With Healthcare… We’re Going To Come Up With Something That’s So Good.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Hagerstown MD, 4/24/16)

Trump: “It’s Not Going To Be Their Plan. It’ll Be Another Plan. But They’ll Be Beautifully Covered.” (Washington Post, 1/15/17) Trump: “Whoever Wants (Heath Care) Is Going To Have It… Nobody Is Dying On The Street If I’m President.” (Greta Town Hall, Fox News, Milwaukee WI, 4/3/16)

Trump: “Everybody’s Got To Be Covered.” (60 Minutes, CBS, 9/27/15) Trump: “We’re Going To Have Insurance For Everybody. There Was A Philosophy In Some Circles That If You Can’t Pay For It, You Don’t Get It. That’s Not Going To Happen With Us.” (Washington Post, 1/15/17)

Trump: “We’re Getting Rid Of Obamacare And We’re Replacing It With Something So Much Better … So Much Less Expensive And Just Better In Every Single Way.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Tucson, AZ, 3/19/16) Trump: “We’re Gonna Terminate Obamacare. We Are Going To Repeal It And Replace It With Great Health Care For Far Less Money.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Phoenix AZ, 3/19/16)

Trump: “Elect Me And We Will Stop The Premium Hikes For Good. We Will Stop The Madness Of Obamacare. It Will Be Repealed And Replaced. Believe Me.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Phoenix AZ, 10/29/16) Trump: “We Will Come Out With Something That Will Be So Good, So Much Less Expensive, So Much Better, It Will Be Wonderful. We’re Going To Take Care Of Everybody.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Jacksonville FL, 8/3/16)

Trump: “We’re Going To Have Great Healthcare. By The Way, For A Fraction Of The Price. Much Less Expensive.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Tampa Bay FL, 3/14/16) Trump: “We’re Going To Terminate Obamacare And We’re Going To Come Up With A Plan That’s Far Better At Far Less Money.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Sarasota, FL, 11/28/15)

Trump: “We’re Going To Terminate Obamacare. We’re Going To Terminate It. It’s Going To Be Terminated. It’s Going To Be Replaced With Something Much Better, And Much Less Expensive For You And For The Country.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Doral, FL, 10/23/15) Trump: “We’re Going To Get Rid Of Obamacare. We’re Going To Win On Healthcare.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Boca Raton, FL, 3/13/16)

Trump: “Obamacare Will Be Repealed And Replaced, Okay? 100%.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Jacksonville, FL, 8/3/16) Trump: “We Have To Get Better Healthcare… Obamacare Is Going To Be Repealed And Replaced With Something So Much Better.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Macon, GA, 11/30/15)

Trump: “We Don’t Win With Healthcare. We’re, By The Way, Terminating Obamacare. We’re Going To Come Up With Something So Good.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Atlanta GA, 2/21/16) Trump: “We Are Going To Start Winning Again, Folks. We’re Going To End Obamacare. We’re Going To Repeal It And Replace It. By The Way, Obamacare Is A Total Disaster.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Atlanta GA, 6/15/16)

Trump: “I’m Asking For Your Vote, So We Can Replace Obamacare … Much Less Expensive, But Better Health Care. Repeal And Replace. We Have So Many Alternatives. So Much Better. So Much Less Expensive.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Grand Rapids MI, 10/31/16) Trump On Obamacare: “It’s Going To Be Terminated And It’s Going To Be Replaced With Something That’s Going To Be Terrific And A Lot Less Expensive And Much Better Coverage.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Cadillac MI, 3/4/16)

Trump: “I’m Asking For Your Votes So That We Can Replace Obamacare And Save Health Care For Every Family From Michigan And In Our Country.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Warren MI, 10/31/16) Trump: “One Of My First Acts As President Will Be To Repeal And Replace Disastrous Obamacare, Saving Another 2 Million American Jobs.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Detroit MI, 8/8/16)

Trump: “We’re Going To Save Health Care For Every Family In Michigan, For Every Family In Our Country. Much Less Expensive, But Better Health Care. Repeal And Replace. We Have So Many Alternatives.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Grand Rapids MI, 10/31/16) Trump: “As I Said, Obamacare Will Be Repealed And Replaced. Voters, Not Special Interest, Will Be In Charge. Finally, We Are Going To Bring Our Country Together Again.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Dimondale MI, 8/19/16)

Donald Trump: “You’re Gonna End Up With Great Health Care For A Fraction Of The Price And That’s Gonna Take Place Immediately After We Go In, Okay, Immediately. Fast, Quick.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Las Vegas NV, 2/22/16) Donald Trump: “We’re Going To Win With Healthcare. We’re Going To Knock Out Obamacare. We’re Going To Come Up With Something So Much Better, So Much Less Expensive… You’re Going To Be Rushing To Get It.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Sparks NV, 2/23/16)

Donald Trump: “We’re Getting Rid Of Obamacare, We’re Going To Come Up With Something That’s Going To Be Much Cheaper And Much Better For The Country And For Yourselves.” (Trump Campaign Rally, South Point NV, 1/21/16) Trump: “You’ll Have Much Better Healthcare At A Much Lower Cost, And It Will Happen Quickly.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Charlotte NC, 8/18/16)

Trump: “We’re Going To Have A New Healthcare Plan That’s Going To Cost Much Less Money, Both For You And For The Country, And It’s Going To Be A Much Higher Quality Healthcare.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Charlotte NC, 10/14/16) Trump On Obamacare: “We’ll Kill It And We’re Going To Start All Over Again With A Great One. You’ll Be Spending A Lot Less Money For Much, Much Better Health Care.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Concord, NC, 11/3/16)

Trump: “One Of The True Staples To My Campaign And I Say To Our Campaign, Repeal And Replace Obamacare.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Fletcher, NC, 10/20/16) Trump: “You’ll Be Spending A Lot Less Money For Much, Much, Better Health Care. Much, Much Less Money.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Charlotte NC, 10/26/16)

Trump: “You’ll Have Great Health Care. Much Less Expense. Much Lower Price. You’ll Be Paying A Fraction Of What You’re Paying And You’re Going To Get Really Good Stuff.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Hershey, PA, 11/4/16) Trump: “We Will Create Quality, Reliable, Affordable Healthcare And A Free Market Where Parents Can Make The Healthcare Decisions That They Really Want To Make For Their Families.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Valley Forge PA, 11/1/16)

Trump: “We’re Going To Repeal It, We’re Going To Replace It With Something Much Better At A Fraction Of The Cost.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Newtown PA, 10/21/16) Trump: My Health Care Plan Is “Going To Be So Much Less Expensive And So Much Better.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Columbus OH, 8/1/16) Trump: “Believe Me. We Are Going To Have Great Healthcare At A Much Lower Price.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Wilmington OH, 11/4/16)

Trump: “We’re Going To Replace Government Run Obamacare With Reforms That Put Patients First.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Toledo OH, 9/21/16) Trump: “I’m Going To Repeal It, Replace It. We’re Going To Have A Replacement That Is So Much Less Expensive And So Much Better.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Springfield OH, 10/27/16)

Trump: “We Will Also Repeal And Replace The Total Disaster Known As Obamacare.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Cleveland OH, 10/22/16) Trump: “We’re Going To Replace (Obamacare) With Something So Much Better And So Much Less Expensive.” (Trump Campaign Rally, Janesville, WI, 3/29/16)

spoken_summary: There is no spoken audio in the video.
audio_music: A solo piano piece with a repetitive, slightly jaunty melody plays continuously throughout the video. The tone can be interpreted as whimsical or mocking, providing a contrast to the serious political subject matter of the on-screen text.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow, transitioning between static text slides at a steady rate.
central_claim: Donald Trump repeatedly and consistently promised for years to replace Obamacare with a better, cheaper healthcare alternative.
intended_effect: To cast doubt on Donald Trump's credibility by highlighting a long series of promises about healthcare, implying that they were never fulfilled.
